name: SIA 334 通讯失效 地面延误

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 334 from Chengdu to Beijing, you are at stand 34, information I received, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 334，从成都飞往北京，在 34 号机位，已收到 I 情报，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Delivery, SIA 334, stand 34, information I, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都放行，SIA 334，34 号机位，收到 I 情报，申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 334, stand by, I am going to check your flight plan.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 334，等待，我将检查你的飞行计划。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 334, Delivery, cleared to Beijing as filed, flight level [unintelligible due to radio interference]
B: The ATC clearance has been disturbed, inform ATC and request repeat the clearance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 334，放行，许可按提交飞行计划飞往北京，高度 ［无线电干扰，内容不清］
B：ATC 放行许可受到干扰，通知 ATC 并请求重复放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Delivery, SIA 334, the ATC clearance has been disturbed, request repeat the clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都放行，SIA 334，ATC 放行许可受到干扰，请求重复放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 334 is cleared to Beijing as filed, 10700 meters, D06 departure, Runway 12, runway heading until passing 3000 meters before turning right, squawk 4562.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 334，许可按提交飞行计划飞往北京，10700 米，D06 离场，跑道 12，保持跑道航向直到通过 3000 米后再右转，应答机 4562。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing as filed, 10700m, D06 departure, Runway 12, runway heading until passing 3000m before turning right, squawk 4562, SIA 334.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按提交飞行计划飞往北京，10700 米，D06 离场，跑道 12，保持跑道航向直到通过 3000 米后再右转，应答机 4562，SIA 334。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 334, readback correct, when ready for push back and start up, contact Ground 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 334，复诵正确，准备好推出和开车时联系地面 118.9。

cards.audioText: B: Before being pushed back, the chief purser calls you that the general declaration form is not on board, inform ATC the situation and request delay the push.
cards.audioTextZh: B：推出前，乘务长通知你总申报单不在机上，通知 ATC 情况并请求延迟推出。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, SIA 334, the chief purser reports that the general declaration form is not on board, request delay the push.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，SIA 334，乘务长报告总申报单不在机上，请求延迟推出。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 334, roger, call me back when ready.

C: SIA 334, are you fully ready now? Your slot is 0310.
B: You need to open the cabin door for the release documents, advise Ground you will need another 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 334，你们现在完全准备好了吗？你的时隙是 0310。
B：你需要打开客舱门取放行文件，告知地面还需要 5 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, SIA 334, we need to open the cabin door for the release documents, request another 5min.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，SIA 334，我们需要打开客舱门取放行文件，请求再给 5 分钟。

cards.audioText: B: Later, the release documents are fully ready, call Ground you are ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：稍后，放行文件全部准备好，呼叫地面你已准备好。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, SIA 334, ready for pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，SIA 334，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 334, push back and startup approved until abeam gate 33, do not block gate 35, there is incoming traffic to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 334，推出和开车批准，推出至正对 33 号登机口，不得阻挡 35 号登机口，有进港航空器要进该登机口。
cards.referenceText: Push back and startup approved until abeam gate 33, do not block gate 35, SIA 334.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，推出至正对 33 号登机口，不得阻挡 35 号登机口，SIA 334。
